title: Browser Audiobook Feature Campaign
objective: Deliver local voice preferences, pre-download audio estimates, a chapter-to-MP3-and-ZIP workflow, and browser-only Markdown and EPUB import without adding accounts, servers, purchases, uploads, or hosted inference.

features.title: Audio duration and MP3 size estimate

invariants.rule: Text, chapters, imported document content, and generated audio are processed only in the visitor browser.
No account, database, server storage, cloud sync, or hosted job state is introduced.
No purchase, VPS, paid speech API, hosted inference, or user-PC service is introduced.
TXT, Markdown, and EPUB files are read locally and the original document is never uploaded.
Analytics and Clarity never receive text, chapter names, document titles, filenames, voice IDs, language choices, audio, or generated output.
Storage, archive entries, extracted bytes, chapters, characters, object URLs, workers, and generated files have explicit limits and cleanup.
The current noindex beta and sitemap policy stay unchanged until the Release and Proof Judge records a separate evidence-backed decision.

agents.name: Voice Preference Agent
agents.goal: Make the 38-voice library easy to revisit using bounded, validated browser-local preferences.

agents.name: Audio Estimate Agent
agents.goal: Show an honest duration and 128 kbps MP3 size estimate before a speech model is requested.

agents.name: Chapter Workflow Agent
agents.goal: Create a bounded chapter editor, sequential one-worker generation queue, and local ZIP download.

agents.name: Document Import and Security Agent
agents.goal: Parse Markdown and EPUB locally into safe ordered chapters while treating every file as untrusted.

agents.name: Product Accessibility and Privacy Agent
agents.goal: Integrate the features without regressions in privacy, accessibility, responsive layout, performance, or browser recovery.

agents.name: Release and Proof Judge
agents.goal: Independently verify final evidence and make the only allowed approval or release decision.

tasks.title: Build a versioned bounded voice preference store
tasks.doneRule: A versioned localStorage record keeps at most 20 favorites and 8 recent valid voice IDs, survives corruption or unavailable storage, and stores no user content or filename.

tasks.title: Add favorites and recent voices to the grouped selector
tasks.doneRule: Users can favorite, unfavorite, and revisit recent voices by keyboard or touch without eager voice/model downloads, layout overflow, or an account.

tasks.title: Implement pure duration and MP3 size estimates
tasks.doneRule: A deterministic estimator returns a clearly labeled duration range and approximate 128 kbps MP3 size for empty, Latin, CJK, RTL, punctuation-heavy, and selected-speed inputs without loading a model.

tasks.title: Show estimates before model download
tasks.doneRule: The estimate is visible and understandable before consent or model loading, updates with text and speed, promises no exact runtime, and a browser trace shows zero model requests.

tasks.title: Define the untrusted document parser contract
tasks.doneRule: The contract pins structured parsers, file/entry/extracted-byte/chapter limits, ZIP path checks, script and remote-resource rejection, text-only output, and no network access.

tasks.title: Parse Markdown into ordered local chapters
tasks.doneRule: A pinned structured Markdown parser extracts headings and plain text into the shared chapter model, never renders imported HTML, and rejects oversized or binary input without truncation.

tasks.title: Parse EPUB spine content into ordered local chapters
tasks.doneRule: A bounded browser ZIP/XML parser follows the EPUB spine, extracts text-only chapters, and rejects DRM, traversal, zip bombs, scripts, remote resources, malformed manifests, and excessive output.

tasks.title: Create the pure chapter model and editor operations
tasks.doneRule: Users can split, name, edit, delete, and reorder bounded chapters with stable IDs, unique sanitized download names, deterministic character totals, and no silent text loss.

tasks.title: Generate chapter MP3 files sequentially with one worker
tasks.doneRule: One loaded model generates chapters in order, exposes per-chapter and overall status, supports cancel and bounded retry, preserves completed local results, and never starts concurrent inference workers.

tasks.title: Download completed chapter MP3 files as a local ZIP
tasks.doneRule: The browser creates one ordered ZIP containing valid separate 128 kbps MP3 files with unique sanitized names, no source text, no remote upload, and revoked object URLs after use.

tasks.title: Benchmark chapter limits and memory cleanup
tasks.doneRule: A measured desktop and mobile-class browser soak passes at the existing 10,000-character aggregate limit with no OOM, orphan worker, object URL, or retained document; any higher limit remains blocked without separate proof.

tasks.title: Integrate responsive accessible privacy-safe controls
tasks.doneRule: Desktop, tablet, and 390px layouts have no overlap or overflow; keyboard and screen-reader flows work; reduced motion is respected; imported/user content is masked and absent from analytics.

tasks.title: Prove cross-browser import, generation, download, and cleanup
tasks.doneRule: Installed Chrome and Edge pass the full flow, fallback engines are truthfully classified, cancellation and refresh clean local resources, and a request sentinel finds no user content or document bytes leaving the page.

tasks.title: Run the independent final evidence audit
tasks.evidenceCommand: npm run agents:tts-feature-campaign:verify && npm run check
tasks.doneRule: The judge reruns every required command from the final commit, inspects browser/privacy evidence, records failures and missing data, and is the only agent allowed to approve tasks.

tasks.title: Make the bounded beta release and index-policy decision
tasks.doneRule: The judge records an explicit release, rollback, and indexability verdict after live Node 24 proof; no sitemap or Search Console submission occurs unless a separate indexability gate passes.
